title: Pseudocode Output (2 points each)
instructions: Read each pseudocode block and write exactly what the print statement outputs.

questions.code:
total = 0
FOR value IN [2, 4, 6]
    total = total + value
END FOR
print(total)

temperature = 72
IF temperature > 80
    print("hot")
ELSE
    print("comfortable")
END IF

count = 1
WHILE count < 4
    print(count)
    count = count + 1
END WHILE
